title: AURA client measurement window (ingress) v1.2
description: Client-emitted ingress window payload. Must not contain server receipt timestamps or boot identity.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark execution.

window_id.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for the measurement window.

client_timestamp_epoch_s.description: Client wall-clock epoch timestamp at window close. Metadata only; never used for freshness.

window_duration_s.description: Strictly positive finite duration of the measurement window in seconds.

requests.description: Total HTTP requests reaching terminal outcome in this window (requests = successes + errors).

successes.description: HTTP requests completing with terminal HTTP 200 within timeout.

errors.description: HTTP requests terminating in failure (timeouts, RST, connection refusals, non-200 HTTP codes).

sample_count.description: Number of successful requests with valid measured monotonic latency samples (sample_count <= successes).

throughput_rps.description: Successful request rate over elapsed window: successes / window_duration_s.

p50_ms.description: 50th percentile (median) successful-response latency in milliseconds using nearest-rank.

p95_ms.description: 95th percentile successful-response latency in milliseconds using nearest-rank.

p99_ms.description: 99th percentile successful-response latency in milliseconds using nearest-rank.

p999_ms.description: 99.9th percentile successful-response latency in milliseconds using nearest-rank.

p99_status.description: Sufficiency status for P99 reporting: minimum_tail_count_met (>=10,000 samples), exploratory (>=100 samples), insufficient (<100 samples).

p999_status.description: Sufficiency status for P99.9 reporting: minimum_tail_count_met (>=100,000 samples), exploratory (>=1,000 samples), insufficient (<1,000 samples).

workers.description: Number of concurrent client worker threads generating load.

metadata.description: Optional run metadata (e.g. client machine hostname, commit SHA).
